material_findings.title: Kiroween 2026 binding rules now published; submissions open and free

facts.entry_cost: No purchase/payment necessary; Kiro free tier $0 with 50 credits, subject to usage limits
facts.participant_eligibility: Adults age of majority; teams max 3; explicit excluded jurisdictions include Quebec, Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Indonesia, Italy, Philippines, Russia, UAE and sanctioned regions; full rules govern
facts.required_tool: Working newly created application using Kiro IDE/CLI/Web/Crew; significant Kiro usage must be shown
facts.required_submission: Public open-source licensed GitHub repo containing root /.kiro directory; runnable app URL; public YouTube demo under 3 minutes; description and Kiro usage writeup
facts.project_start_boundary: Only projects newly created after Oct 30 09:00 PT; prior existing suite is not a qualifying project as-is
facts.prize_evidence: Overview advertises $100,000 cash; rules list $94,000 in explicitly straightforward cash categories plus four student awards each described as $1,500 USD and one-year Kiro Pro Max subscription; overview separately explicitly labels each student prize $1,500 cash plus subscription, reconciling total to $100,000 cash; conditional award, no guaranteed payout
facts.credit_offer: Organizer resources offer one-time 4,000 Kiro credits on request with Kiro account and ID by Dec 1 12:00 PT; redemption by Dec 4; expires Dec 31
